summary:
EarthPulse is an AI-powered satellite monitoring platform designed to visualize, analyze, and understand changes occurring across Earth's surface. Inspired by NASA's NISAR mission, EarthPulse explores the potential of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) technology to monitor environmental and human-induced changes, even through clouds and during nighttime.

The platform aims to support monitoring across six major areas: forest and wetland changes, agricultural activities, wildfires, earthquakes and ground movement, glaciers, and other environmental transformations.

By combining satellite observations, AI-assisted analysis, geospatial visualization, and interactive dashboards, EarthPulse transforms complex Earth observation information into meaningful insights. Users can explore locations, compare changes over time, identify potential environmental risks, and better understand how our planet is evolving.

Our goal is to make satellite-based Earth monitoring more accessible, understandable, and useful for environmental awareness, research, and informed decision-making.
details:
EarthPulse – Project Details

1. What Does Our Project Do?

EarthPulse is an AI-powered Earth observation and satellite monitoring platform designed to help users understand how Earth's surface changes over time. It brings multiple environmental monitoring applications together in one interactive platform, inspired by NASA's NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) mission.

The platform focuses on six major areas: forest and wetland monitoring, agricultural changes, wildfire impacts, earthquake-related ground movement, glacier monitoring, and other environmental transformations.

2. How Does It Work?

EarthPulse is designed to combine satellite observations, geospatial information, AI-assisted analysis, and interactive visualizations. Users can explore geographical regions, understand environmental changes, and view monitoring insights through an accessible dashboard.

The project is inspired by NISAR's Synthetic Aperture Radar technology, which uses microwave signals instead of relying on sunlight to observe Earth's surface. This allows radar observations during both day and night and through many cloud conditions.

3. Benefits and Intended Impact

  • Makes complex satellite observation concepts easier to understand.
  • Supports environmental awareness and monitoring.
  • Helps users explore potential environmental changes.
  • Brings multiple Earth observation applications into one platform.
  • Demonstrates how AI and satellite technology can support environmental research and informed decision-making.

4. Technologies Used

Frontend: React.js, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind CSS.

Development Tools: Visual Studio Code, Git and GitHub.

Deployment: Cloud-based web hosting.

AI Assistance: AI tools were used to support development, problem-solving, code assistance, and project documentation.

5. What Makes EarthPulse Creative?

The key innovation is bringing six different Earth monitoring applications into one unified interactive experience. Instead of presenting satellite information as complicated scientific data, EarthPulse aims to make it understandable through visual exploration, interactive dashboards, and AI-assisted insights.

The platform connects the potential of NASA's NISAR mission with practical environmental monitoring applications.

6. Factors Considered

Our team considered accessibility, usability, environmental relevance, scalability, data visualization, and the importance of reliable satellite observations. We also considered how to make complex scientific information understandable to students, researchers, and the general public.

Our Vision

EarthPulse aims to turn satellite observations into meaningful environmental insights and help people better understand our changing planet.

One Earth. Countless Changes. One Platform to Understand Them.
